source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current service contract, safety method, legal duty, warning semantic or reporting route verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material live-state, property-scope, coverage, cumulative-snapshot or series-break caveat

quality_guards: Live flood-alert counts and five-day forecasts are stored with their verification time and must be rechecked.
Long-term flood-risk results describe land or area risk and do not state the probability that an individual property will flood.
Groundwater coverage is incomplete in parts of England and is never silently filled.
Weather-Health Alerts and National Severe Weather Warnings have different impact scopes and are not treated as interchangeable.
Current alert colours and affected regions are dynamic operational states.
A paid coal-mining report is not inferred from the free initial area search.
Absence of a historical mining record is not treated as proof that mining did not occur.
NCSC cumulative scam-removal totals are timestamped snapshots.
The NCSC 2022-23 tip series has a collection-method break and is not compared directly with earlier years.
Coastal tide, weather and rescue information remains situational and is not converted into a static parcel safety score.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
